RetieredSegment.description:
A segment the reviewer re-ranked — addressed by where it starts.

Its start, not its whole span: a tier is an argument about a passage, and the
passage is identified by where it begins (§4.4).
RetieredSegment.title: RetieredSegment

Tier.description:
How good a segment is — aspect-independent taste, decided once (§4.4.1).

Which tiers survive is a *separate*, per-profile, arithmetic decision driven
by `duration_budget`. Tiers are a ranking, not a cut.
Tier.title: Tier
